propositions.proposition: Orvan Grain Port infrastructure was physically destroyed in military strikes.

qualifying.quote_or_value: Two grain berths are closed. The port is loading at reduced speed on the berths that remain open.
qualifying.reliability_note: MEDIUM: Shipping update from a trade publication, may not be fully authoritative.
qualifying.establishes: a qualification (ORV-0008 | Page 1 | Paragraph 2 (report, Cargo Weekly)): Does not confirm physical destruction; only indicates operational limitations.
qualifying.does_not_establish: the proposition, or that it is false

qualifying.quote_or_value: The port authority says it cannot estimate when normal working will resume.
qualifying.reliability_note: HIGH: Official statement from the port authority regarding operations.
qualifying.establishes: a qualification (ORV-0008 | Page 1 | Paragraph 5 (official statement, Cargo Weekly)): Does not specify reasons for operational issues; does not confirm destruction.
qualifying.does_not_establish: the proposition, or that it is false

qualifying.quote_or_value: Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.
qualifying.reliability_note: MEDIUM: The source is a government notice, which may provide official information but does not confirm destruction.
qualifying.establishes: a qualification (ORV-0032 | Page 1 | Paragraph 2 (observation, Realm Trade Ministry)): Does not confirm physical destruction of infrastructure; only indicates operational status of berths.
qualifying.does_not_establish: the proposition, or that it is false

qualifying.quote_or_value: The port strike that began in September has left berth availability below normal.
qualifying.reliability_note: MEDIUM: A shipping update that reports on port operations but does not confirm destruction.
qualifying.establishes: a qualification (ORV-0035 | Page 1 | Paragraph 3 (report, Cargo Weekly)): Does not provide evidence of physical destruction; focuses on berth availability.
qualifying.does_not_establish: the proposition, or that it is false
